title: SDK transport presets for mixed-latency workloads and streaming ergonomics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: SDK users across Python/TS/Go frequently ask for example transport configs tuned to real-world mixed-latency workloads (interactive chat, background batch embeddings, and long-lived streams). Current guidance is fragmented and often requires trial-and-error. Goal: deliver a set of named, documented transport presets (and short code examples) that teams can adopt as a starting point, plus minimal runtime telemetry to validate behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver 3 named presets: latency-sensitive, throughput-optimized, balanced-streaming
Provide 1 simple code example per SDK (Python, TypeScript, Go) showing how to apply a preset
Document expected CPU/GPU and connection behavior and trade-offs in the SDK README
Add telemetry events for connection pool reuse, keepalive pings, and per-route deadline breaches
Merge PRs with tests + integration run demonstrating p95 latency within target for latency preset
comments: 2026-03-10 - Triage: Captured recurring customer asks and notes from support tickets (embed-heavy workloads failing under default pooling). Assigned to Miguel.
2026-03-11 - Design meeting notes: short presets are preferable to full knobs UI; UX to expose "preset" string + optional overrides. Suggested names: latency-low, throughput-high, balanced-stream.

2026-03-12 - Engineering: ran quick perf run against workload simulator: baseline default -> p95: 220ms, throughput-high -> p95: 380ms but 2x throughput, latency-low -> p95: 150ms with higher CPU. Logged results to dashboard: https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/transport-presets/ENG-127451

2026-03-12 - Decision: Streaming retry semantics decoupled from unary retries. For streams we will: (1) prefer reconnect-with-checkpoint when supported, (2) use conservative keepalive to avoid mid-stream disconnects, (3) expose a 'stream_grace' small timeout for in-flight events.
2026-03-13 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4892 - adds preset registry + Python/TS/Go examples. Marked as draft pending tests and doc polish.
2026-03-13 - Review feedback from Lina (SDK lead): add explicit guidance for idempotency assumptions; call out GC impact on long-lived connections and recommend pool pruning heuristics.

2026-03-14 - Perf update: after adjusting keepalive from 60s->20s for balanced-stream, observed connection churn drop of ~28% and 12% reduction in failed streams in simulator. Will include these numbers in README.
Action items: finish unit tests (Miguel), add telemetry hooks (Jae), update docs and example README (Aisha), schedule cross-sdk API review (Mar 17).
examples:
Python example:
from redwood_sdk import Client
client = Client(transport_preset=\"latency-low\", transport_overrides={\"pool_max_size\": 8, \"keepalive_secs\": 20})
resp = client.generate(\"hello\")

Go example:
cfg := sdk.DefaultConfig()
cfg.Transport.Preset = \"throughput-high\"
cfg.Transport.Overrides = map[string]interface{}{\"pool_max_size\": 64, \"keepalive_secs\": 60}
client := sdk.NewClient(cfg)
